structured_stats.description:
The '''Farm''' is an intermediate cash-generating [[tower]] that can be purchased from the store for {{Coins|2,000}}.

The '''Farm''' generates cash for the player at the beginning of each wave, instantly giving the player a cash bonus. It does not do anything during the wave itself, and is solely a source of bonus income. 

The '''Farm''' cannot damage by normal means. The only way to deal damage is by placing the '''Farm''' in the range of a [[Harvester]], which will make the '''Farm''' create thorns while the [[Harvester]]'s ''Thorns'' ability is being used. Thorns generated by a '''Farm''' have their damage, duration and range statistics halved, though their power (except the range) increases with Levels, becoming same strength as the [[Harvester]] at Level 5. Tick and slowdown are seemingly unaffected by this and are the same as the [[Harvester]].

It can also be strategically used to make more money for the respective player, allowing them to buy more expensive towers and upgrades sooner. The '''Farm''', if used appropriately, can be extremely beneficial in obtaining expensive towers like the [[Turret]], [[Ranger]] and [[Accelerator]] earlier than usual. The '''Farm''' also has a slightly larger placement footprint than other towers, though it is smaller than the [[Turret]].

The '''Farm''' has a placement limit of ten per player. This is decreased to eight in [[PVP]] mode.

It makes [[Farm]]s not generate any cash when used. '''Farm Banned''' is active on all matches in [[Failed Gateway]], [[The Nightmare Realm]] and [[Containment]]. ==Effects== When the '''Farm Banned''' modifier is active, [[Farm]]s will generate zero cash, rendering them useless. It can still generate thorns in conjugation with the [[Harvester]]. The [[Cowboy]] and [[DJ Booth]]'s cash generations are unaffected. ==Trivia== *The effect this modifier applies has been in the game for years, being used in multiple events, such as [[Halloween 2020 Event|Halloween 2020]]. **However, there was no indicator that the generation of cash through the [[Farm]] was disabled until [[Hexscape Event]], though the indicator was only added a few days after its release. *While the '''Farm Banned''' modifier did not disable the placement of the [[Farm]] outright, [[Cold Ambush]] and [[D00M's Revenge]] did, though not through a modifier. *The icon for this modifier uses the Level 4 Default [[Farm]] gallery image which is used on this wiki, with the photo being captured and uploaded by [[User:WikiaColors|WikiaColors]]. ==Update History== *'''25 October 2024''' - [[v1.38.0|v1.38.2]] **'''Farm Banned''' added. *'''30 October 2024''' - [[v1.39.0]] **'''Farm Banned''' is now active in [[Containment]]. {{ModifierNavBox}}

It has been remade twice since its addition to the game. '''Farm Lands''' has the [[Enemies Beta]] modifier, which changes the appearance of some enemies, replaces some enemies with other enemies and changes stats of some enemies. ==Design & Path== {{Tabber |Current |The current version of '''Farm Lands''' takes place on a large farm plain surrounded by hills, a cliff and large patches of farmland. In the background, a large stone bridge can be seen. On the farm, there is a green wooden two story house and a red wooden barn. There are also 4 green houses, two water tanks, a water tower, a well, a mailbox and a board set on the property. A green car, red truck and red tractor can be found on the farm. Multiple trees, rocks, red barrels, cable reels and hay bales are also scattered across the map. The path starts at a cave, goes around the water tower and truck, around the water tanks and then goes straight into the barn. |Version 3 |The third version of '''Farm Lands''' took place on a large farm plain with gentle hills. In the background, another farm could be seen. Separating the main farm and far farm were wheatfields with hay bales. On the main farm, multiple farm barns and farmhouses could be seen. Various water tanks and grain silos could be seen. Small scale grainfields, fences and hay bales could also be seen. Several birch and oak trees could be seen. The brown pebble path begins at a cave and ends at a barn. |Version 2 |The second version of '''Farm Lands''' is identical to the first version, except terrain water surrounded the map, instead of baseplate water. |Version 1 |The first version of '''Farm Lands''' took place a farming island in the middle of the ocean. Green fields could be seen across the map. Barns, wheatfields, hay bales, silos, windmills and trees could also be seen across the map. There were also hill mounds to place cliff towers on. The path started at a cave and ended at a barn. It took a roughly circular path around the map. }} ==Interactive Map== {{Map:Farm Lands}} ==Rewards== The game calculates how many {{Coins|Coins}}, {{Gem|Gems}} and {{Exp|}} you receive based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 100% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned is multiplied by 2x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplies any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. These two boosts are additive. Regular {{Exp|}} boosts are multiplicative with other modifiers present on this map. Any rewards that end in a decimal point is rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal. {{Rewards|Normal|Hardcore = Hide|Voidcore = Hide}} ==Strategy== *The path on this map is quite compact, meaning that high range towers such as the [[Turret]], [[Ranger]] or [[Mortar]] can cover most or all the path with proper positioning. **Additionally, you can use [[DJ Booth]] to boost the range of said towers, further increasing their effectiveness. *The path's shape is ideal for the [[Ace Pilot]] and [[Pursuit]], as it allows them to cover a part of the path for most of their flight path. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Map Icons}} Farm Lands.png|First & second versions (25 November 2019 – 8 May 2021) FL logo.png|Third version (8 May 2021 – 24 June 2023) {{GalleryHeader|View}} FLView.png|First version (25 November 2019 – 29 Octo

==Description==
The '''Discount Buff''' is a buff that decreases a tower's upgrade and ability usage costs. This does not decrease the placement cost of a tower. The buff is displayed on the affected towers using an icon of a green tag.

==Mechanics==
When applied, all upgrade costs and ability usage costs will be reduced using this equation:
::<big>'''Cost × (1 - Discount Buff)'''</big>
:::where '''Discount Buff''' is the buff supplied in decimal form (for example, 10% is 0.1).

The upgrade cost is rounded down to the nearest integer. Towers that were upgraded while being affected the '''Discount Buff''' will give you less cash back when they are sold, in comparison to those that were not affected by it. The sell prices are permanently affected.

The following towers cannot have their costs partially or fully decreased by the '''Discount Buff''':
*[[Farm]]

==Applied By==
The following tower can apply the '''Discount Buff''' to other towers:
*[[DJ Booth]] (Passive)

related_pages.wikitext_excerpt:
{{AttributeInfobox |image1 = Freeze.png |type = Immunity |variants = Regular
{{Boss}}[[Boss]] |immunities = Regular: *{{Freeze|Freeze}}Freeze *{{Freeze|Chillness}}Chillness *{{Freeze|Freeze Defense Dropping}}Freeze Defense Dropping *[[File:SledgerLevel2.png|20px|Sledger Ice Breaker]][[Sledger]] Ice Breaker {{Boss}}[[Boss]]: *{{Freeze|Freeze}}Freeze *{{Freeze|Partial Chillness}}Partial Chillness Towers & Units: *{{Freeze|Enemy Freeze}}Enemy Freeze |sandbox = No |tag = {{AttrTag|Second|Freeze.png|No Freeze}} }} ==Description== '''Freeze Immunity''' (with its tag referring to it as "''No Freeze''") is an immunity that prevents the enemy from being frozen and chilled. For towers and units, it prevents them from being frozen. ==Mechanics== '''Freeze Immunity''' makes it so that the enemy cannot be frozen. Additionally, it stops the enemy from being chilled by them. Because of its chillness immunity, it also prevents the enemies from having their defense dropped by freezing towers. Additionally, as the [[Sledger]] deals double damage to frozen or chilled enemies, it cannot deal double damage to them. Larger enemies are also frozen for a shorter amount of time than average sized enemies. The following towers/consumables become unable to apply these freeze based effects to '''Freeze Immune''' enemies: *[[Freezer]] *[[Frost Blaster]] *[[Sledger]] *[[Jester]] *[[Cryomancer]] *[[Snowballer]] *[[Elementalist]] *[[Blizzard Bomb]] *[[Pumpkin Bomb]] *[[Santa's Air Strike]] *[[Ducky Squad]] ([[Ice Ducky]]) '''Freeze Immunity''' is given to all [[Boss]] enemies, though that immunity is different from the regular one. Both version are immune to being frozen, however, it is only partially immune to chillness. It is slowed down less by chillness, but it is not immune to it. This means that bosses can have their defense dropped and can be dealt double damage to by the [[Sledger]], as long as the enemy does not have the regular '''Freeze Immunity'''. '''Freeze Immunity''' also used to prevent enemies from being slowed down from frost mark while it was still in the game. While the [[Freezer]] dealt splash damage, it could not freeze any enemy with [[Splash Damage Immunity]]. However, these enemies could still be frozen by the [[Frost Blaster]] or through its ''Ice Age'' ability. Before the [[Release v1.0|MEGA Update]], there was an additional type of '''Freeze Immunity''', referred to as '''Basic Freeze'''. These enemies could not be frozen by the [[Freezer]]'s main attack, but could be frozen through its ''Ice Drop'' ability. ===Towers=== Certain towers and units also have the '''Freeze Immunity''', which prevents them from being frozen, though it does not prevent them from being targeted. An [[Unstable Ice]] from the [[Operation I.C.E Event]] will still target a freeze immune [[Molten Monster]], even though it not only deals no damage but also does not freeze it. ==Enemy List== The following enemies have '''Freeze Immunity''': *[[Hazmat]] *[[Fallen Hazmat]] *[[Elite Hazmat]] *[[Elite Molten]] *[[Tanker]] *[[Molten Summoner]] *[[Giant Boss]] *[[Summoner Boss]] *[[Speedy King (Legacy)|Speedy King]] (Legacy version) *[[Hazardous]] *[[Amalgamation]] (Modern version) *[[Circuit (Polluted Wasteland II)|Circuit]] (Modern [[Polluted Wasteland II]] version) *[[Abomination]] (Legacy version) *[[Super Toxic]] (Modern version) *[[Necromancer King]] *[[Nuclear Guardian]] *[[Conjurer]] *[[Shotgunner (Pizza Party)|Shotgunner]] *[[Commander (Pizza Party)|Commander]] *[[Cavalry]] (Modern version) *[[Patient Zero]] *[[Awakened Fallen King]] *[[Molten Hazmat]] *[[Blizzard Wizard]] *[[Frost Ravager]] (With shield) *[[Deep Freeze]] *[[Frost Necromancer]] *[[Frost Champion]] *[[Void Reaper]] *[[Mandragora]] *[[Slow King]] (Modern version, with Forcefield) *[[Crystalian]] *[[Void Trickster]] *[[Void Portal]] *[[Void Cultist]] *[[Healing Beacon]] *[[Void Eye]] *[[Void Knight]] *[[Void Guardian]] *[[Golden Mystery]] All [[Boss]] enemies have their own varian

Build up chill to slow and freeze enemies in their tracks!|Store Description}} |-|Version 3 = {{QuoteBox|Chill enemies to a slow freeze!|Store Description}} |-|Version 2 = {{QuoteBox|Shoot an ice beam, freezing targets for a few seconds.|Store Description}} |-|Version 1 = {{QuoteBox|Freeze zombies temporarily with a freeze ray!|Former Store Description}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Freezer''' is a ground [[Towers|tower]] that fires an ice beam and applies chill and slow down enemies, freezing at later levels. It can be bought in the store for {{Coins|650}}. The '''Freezer''' targets a single enemy and fires a ''Frost Ray'', chilling the enemy and slowing it down. The chillness slowness effect stacks with each hit multiple times. This chillness effect also deals damage over time, chipping away the health of enemies affected by it. Starting from Level 2, it can freeze enemies. When the chillness slowness effect is higher than the max slowdown, the enemy will be frozen, which generally when targeting a single enemy takes four or five shots. Larger enemies will be frozen for a shorter amount of time than average sized enemies. Enemies with [[Freeze Immunity]] also cannot be frozen, slowed down or have their defense dropped by the '''Freezer'''. At Level 3+, the '''Freezer''' fires in bursts, with a short delay between them. Additionally, at Level 3+, it drops defense by 10% every tick. It can only decrease an enemy's defense by 33%. For example, if an enemy has 50% defense, it will be decreased by 16%. On top of this, it will also start dealing damage over time with its chill at Level 3. Additionally at Level 4, the '''Freezer''' gains the ability to throw a '''Frost Grenade''', freezing enemies within an explosion radius. The '''Freezer''' does well as an all-rounder support tower. Due to its generally low price and decent DPS, the '''Freezer''' can be a solid choice for early-game defense to mid game with very good cost efficiency. Towards late game, the '''Freezer''' is useful for stalling, defense melting and deal additional DPS through its damage over time, though its DPS is insufficient to deal with late-game waves alone. The '''Freezer''' has [[Lead (Attribute)|lead]] detection from Level 0 and [[Hidden (Attribute)|hidden]] detection from level 2. It has no placement limit. ==Upgrades== {{PVPTabber |{{Upgrade|Level = Level 1|Upgrade Title = Expedition Gear|Cost = {{Money|300}}|Image = [[File:Freezer Upgrade 1.png|100px]]|Information = 0.55 > 0.35 Firerate [[File:Cooldown Icon.png|20px|Firerate]] 15% > 20% Max Slowdown [[File:Slowness.png|20px|Ma
